_comment: The field run protocol every driver and field report collector shares: a collector writes a request file the running driver picks up, the driver runs its declared steps with no person, writes one result per step and a done marker, and the collector copies them. macOS was first (macos/data/field_run.json, read by infra/field_run.lua); its protocol keys must stay equal to these (tools/test/test-field-run-protocol.cjs).

Each driver declares its own steps in its own file (steps_file); a step is {id, kind, deadline_seconds, proves} plus check for a field_check step. A result is written as <results>/<request_id>/<NN>_<step id>.json, NN the step's two-digit position in the run.

The folder: a developer run from a clone uses folder.clone (relative to the clone root); an installed driver uses folder.<os>, the base an environment variable and the segments joined to it. A collector looks in the developer folder first, then the installed one.
Documents lists the keys each file carries; a driver may add keys, never drop one. Every value a driver writes is a closed code, a count, a duration or a time: no typed text, path, URL or user name.
